# AI Pilot to Production

> AI strategy and delivery practice of Parag Kudtarkar: AI use-case discovery, AI Centre of Excellence design and leadership, responsible AI governance, and taking AI pilots into production. 22+ years across healthcare, telecommunications and regulated sectors in APAC. Singapore-based, working globally.

This site answers what an AI consultancy does, how AI Centres of Excellence are built and led, how AI pilots move to production, and how responsible AI (security, governance, ethics) is applied in delivery. The assistant "Orbit" answers from the same knowledge base.

## Offer — Managed AI Operations

- Managed AI Operations: for mid-size companies (US & UK), a fixed monthly retainer
  (USD 4,000 / approx GBP 3,200) covering up to 10 active AI use cases per company —
  governance, security guardrails, vendor triage, hands-on delivery, monthly KPI report.
  Month-to-month. Entry point: two-week AI Readiness Sprint (audit, 10-use-case
  portfolio, 90-day roadmap).
